answer: Graduated stake tiers make fake crowds costly: each funder locks 25 POA for the first identity and 1.5 times more for every extra one, so ten identities need over 1900 POA. A harbor registry records funding sources, and an auditor who can wander through transfer graphs flags shared funders, slashing 30 percent of locked stake. Honest users pay once, but a fable of many accounts grows exponentially expensive.
